foodForest.title: Pecan
lines: Okukhona: 1; okuhleliwe: 1. Okukhiqizwayo: intongomane elisegobolondweni (nut in shell).

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-5. Ukuthela okuncane cishe ngonyaka wesi-5 encwadini yase-KZN, ezindaweni eziniselwayo ezinehlobo elishisayo, ubusika obubandayo nomswakama ophansi ngesikhathi sokukhula. Ikhomba izigodi zemifula ezomile zase-Zululand/Lowveld njengezindawo zesifunda ezifanelekile. Indlela yokwandisa, uhlobo nobudala basenkulisa akucacisiwe; lesi isikhombo esijwayelekile esinemibandela, akulona inani elilindelekile epulazini. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sokukhiqiza osekusimeme: iminyaka engu-12–13. Ukukhiqiza okugcwele cishe ngeminyaka engu-12–13 encwadini ejwayelekile yase-KZN. Uhlobo olukhethiwe, indlela yokwandisa, ukuminyana nokuphathwa kuthinta ukukhiqiza kwangempela; ubudala bokuvuthwa abuzakheli ngokuzenzakalela igrafu yama-kg ngesihlahla ngonyaka.

Okukhiqizwa komhlahlandlela we-pecan — isisekelo sehektare samantongomane omile asemagobolondweni: Umhlahlandlela unikeza u-750 oqaphile, isilinganiso esingu-800–1,200 kanye no-1,500+ omuhle we-kg/ha wamantongomane omile asemagobolondweni (Dry-in-Shell). Ubala ngokwehlukana ezinye izikhala phakathi kwezihlahla nokunciphiswa kwezihlahla kamuva, ngakho akucatshangwa ukuminyana okukodwa. Lezi yizinkomba zehektare ezingaboshelwe eminyakeni yobudala; isisindo esinegobolondo asisona isisindo somongo odliwayo futhi alukho ijika elijwayelekile le-kg/tree elisuselwa kuzo.

Sebenzisa izinhlobo ezikhipha impova neziyemukelayo ezihambisanayo. Izindawo ezinemvula yasehlobo zidinga izinhlobo ezimelana nesifo se-scab; ukuvuthwa kwamantongomane kusenesikhathi kukodwa akuqinisekisi ukuhambisana kwempova.

Iseluleko sokuthenga: Uhlu olufushane lwe-SAPPA: e-KZN/Lowveld enomswakama omningi — Ukulinga, Cape Fear, Choctaw; e-KZN emanzi nebandayo kakhulu — Barton; e-Highveld eyomile kakhudlwana — Barton, Pawnee, Wichita; ezindaweni ezomile zasentshonalanga — Wichita, Choctaw, Western Schley. Iqembu lesimo sezulu elicatshangelwe lodwa alikwazi ukuhlukanisa zonke lezi zindawo. Qinisekisa umswakama wendawo, umhlabathi nezinhlobo ezimbili zempova ngaphambi kokuthenga.
Impova: idinga impova yesinye isitshalo esihambisanayo. Hlola izidingo zohlobo olukhethiwe nenkulisa yezitshalo.
Isikhathi sokuvuna esilindelwe: alukho uhlobo olulodwa lwendawo olunefasitela eliqinisekisiwe. Izikhathi eziyizinkomba ezingezansi azisona isibikezelo.
Inkomba kuphela — South Africa (ngokujwayelekile — umjikelezo wezinkathi zezitshalo eNingizimu Yenkabazwe; izindawo eziyinhloko i-Vaalharts/Northern Cape, Lower Orange River): Mas–Jun.

foodForest.title: Mango
lines: Okukhona: 1; okuhleliwe: 1. Okukhiqizwayo: izithelo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: iminyaka engu-3–4. Izitshalo zomango ezixhunyelelwe encwadini yase-KZN ngokuvamile ziqala ukuthela emva kweminyaka engu-3–4. Isimo esichaziwe ukukhiqiza endaweni engenasithwathwa, eshisayo/efudumele eseduze nesimo sasezindaweni ezishisayo, enomswakama ophansi ngesikhathi sokuqhakaza, kuhlanganisa i-Zululand eyomile, i-Valley Bushveld ne-Lowveld. Umbhalo uhlukanisa izitshalo ezixhunyelelwe ne-Peach/Sabre ekhuliswe ngembewu; ungasebenzisi lobu budala esithombeni esingaqoshiwe noma ucabange ama-kg onyaka. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Grafted mango establishment — regional guide: Grafted stock generally first bears around 3–4 years and may remain productive 20 years or longer under the guide conditions. Seed-raised trees are a separate planting-material case. Frost, wet spring flowering conditions, cultivar and field establishment must be checked; longevity is not an age-yield curve.
Hlola isithwathwa, ukuphuma kwamanzi nobungozi bezifo ngesikhathi sokuqhakaza. Ukuzwela ekushiseni nasekushisweni yilanga kuyehluka ngezinhlobo.

Iseluleko sokuthenga: I-ARC ibala i-Tommy Atkins ne-Kent phakathi kwezinhlobo ezibekezelela ukushisa/ukushiswa yilanga kangcono; i-Sensation ne-Keitt zithinteka kalula. Qinisekisa izinsuku zokuvuna zendawo ngaphambi kokukhetha izinhlobo ezilandelanayo.
Isikhathi sokuvuna esilindelwe: alukho uhlobo olulodwa lwendawo olunefasitela eliqinisekisiwe. Izikhathi eziyizinkomba ezingezansi azisona isibikezelo.
Inkomba kuphela — South Africa (ngokujwayelekile; Limpopo + Mpumalanga = 96% yendawo yama-mango yase-SA): Nov–Mas.

sources.label: ARC Climate-Smart Agriculture, module 6, printed pp. 239–242

KZN DARD, Fruit and Nut Production in KZN, Mango bearing age; printed p.16, p. 20

foodForest.title: Purple granadilla
lines: Okukhona: 1; okuhleliwe: 1. Okukhiqizwayo: izithelo.

Isikhombo sesivuno sokuqala: izinyanga ezingu-6–8. Isikhombo sase-KZN: izinyanga ezingu-6–8 emva kokutshala izithombo, cishe iminyaka engu-0.5–0.67. Lesi isikhathi esiphakathi kokutshala nokuvuna kokuqala, akulona ikhalenda lokukha lesifunda. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.

Isikhombo sokukhiqiza osekusimeme: iminyaka engu-1.5. Incwadi yase-KZN ithi ukuthela ngokugcwele kungakapheli izinyanga ezingu-18. Lesi isikhombo sesikhathi esingumkhawulo ongaphezulu, akusona isithembiso samakhilogremu okudla ngonyaka.
Faka izisekelo zokukhuphuka futhi uthene; gwema ukugcwala kwamanzi uhlole ukubola kwezimpande nezinkinga zamagciwane.
Iseluleko sokuthenga: I-purple granadilla iyireferensi yezithelo ezintsha yase-KZN; izinhlobo eziphuzi zimuncu kakhulu futhi zisetshenziselwa ujusi. Qinisekisa impilo yezitshalo nesikhathi sendawo.
Isikhathi sokuvuna esilindelwe: alukho uhlobo olulodwa lwendawo olunefasitela eliqinisekisiwe. Izikhathi eziyizinkomba ezingezansi azisona isibikezelo.
Inkomba kuphela — KwaZulu-Natal (amaqembu e-Bioresource Groups 3 no-5, indawo epholile eseduze nezishisayo): Jun–Jul, Nov–Jan.

sources.label: KZN DARD, Fruit and Nut Production, PDF pp. 14–15 (regional reference; confirm current nursery stock)

foodForest.title: Wild medlar
lines: Okukhona: 1; okuhleliwe: 1. Okukhiqizwayo: Izithelo ezivuthiwe, ezintsha noma ezomisiwe.
Isikhathi sesivuno sokuqala: asitholakali emthonjeni; ungathembeli ezitshalweni ezisanda kutshalwa ukuze uthole ukudla ngokushesha.

Wider fruiting observations, not a ripe picking interval: This account separately distinguishes green unripe and brown ripe fruit, but its November–April biology sentence does not date that ripening change. The wider interval remains southern African phenology. SANBI's January–April description of ripe edible fruit supplies the food-ready regional reference.
Qinisekisa izimo zokusimama endaweni ngaphambi kokuthembela kureferensi yesifunda yokuthela izithelo.
Iseluleko sokuthenga: Cela izitshalo ezithela izithelo ezifanele indawo; alukho uhlobo oluqanjwe igama olunomthombo.
Isikhathi sokuvuna esilindelwe: alukho uhlobo olulodwa lwendawo olunefasitela eliqinisekisiwe. Izikhathi eziyizinkomba ezingezansi azisona isibikezelo.
Inkomba kuphela — South Africa (ngokujwayelekile; ukusabalala e-SA kunikezwe njenge-Eastern Cape, Free State, Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo, Mpumalanga, North West, Northern Cape): Jan–Eph.

izithombo, cishe iminyaka engu-0.5–0.67. Lesi isikhathi esiphakathi kokutshala nokuvuna kokuqala, akulona
ikhalenda lokukha lesifunda. Isikhathi sangempela sincike ohlotsheni nasekunakekelweni kwendawo.
Isikhombo sokukhiqiza osekusimeme: iminyaka engu-1.5. Incwadi yase-KZN ithi ukuthela ngokugcwele
kungakapheli izinyanga ezingu-18. Lesi isikhombo sesikhathi esingumkhawulo ongaphezulu, akusona isithembiso
samakhilogremu okudla ngonyaka.
Faka izisekelo zokukhuphuka futhi uthene; gwema ukugcwala kwamanzi uhlole ukubola kwezimpande nezinkinga
zamagciwane.
Iseluleko sokuthenga: I-purple granadilla iyireferensi yezithelo ezintsha yase-KZN; izinhlobo eziphuzi zimuncu
kakhulu futhi zisetshenziselwa ujusi. Qinisekisa impilo yezitshalo nesikhathi sendawo.
Isikhathi sokuvuna esilindelwe: alukho uhlobo olulodwa lwendawo olunefasitela eliqinisekisiwe. Izikhathi
eziyizinkomba ezingezansi azisona isibikezelo.
Inkomba kuphela — KwaZulu-Natal (amaqembu e-Bioresource Groups 3 no-5, indawo epholile eseduze
nezishisayo): Jun–Jul, Nov–Jan.
